activity_summary: Dead by the fourth act, you stood at the tiring-house door. Margery had twenty-six shillings in her stair and will not see a black gown till Michaelmas. Sly had the Admiral's men in Kent or the west and would not choose. You kept tomorrow at ten, and you did not follow the mules.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named tomorrow at ten, and chose no shire.

entities.name: Goodwife Margery Pell
entities.context: Counted twenty-six shillings, and kept them.

entities.name: William Sly
entities.context: Offered Kent or the west, and refused to marry them.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Tomorrow at ten. That is the only hour I am keeping.
